integrity: The analytical inequalities prove the global and asymptotic claims. Finite checker output supports reproducibility but is not a proof of continuum or asymptotic assertions.
scientific_limitations: Closed deterministic SIR, homogeneous mixing, positive initially infected mass, fixed allocation, prevention and treatment coefficients strictly positive; all-growing condition for unique peak optimum; no general person-time optimizer uniqueness claim.
title: An interior peak-optimal SIR budget split spends strictly more on prevention than an infectious-person-time optimum
